description: A couple pose side by side in a white panelled room next to a potted olive tree, changing outfits between shots. They start in matching light blue: she in a light blue satin shirt tied at the waist with white trousers and a light blue bag, he in a light blue linen shirt with white trousers. Then she wears a blue draped top with brown flared trousers while he wears a brown polo with light blue trousers, then both are in chocolate brown and cream, and finally both wear dark green cable-knit jumpers, hers over a camel skirt with tall suede boots, his with camel chinos.
transcript: Remember, light blue with white looks good, but light blue with brown is unbeatable. Chocolate with cream looks luxurious and forest green with camel looks next level.
